name: gbs-software-agent
description: An autonomous coding agent for VS Code powered by local (Ollama) or OpenAI-compatible models.

enumDescriptions: Any OpenAI-compatible /chat/completions endpoint (Hugging Face router, vLLM, LM Studio, OpenRouter, ...)

gbsAgent.model.description: Model used by the main agent.

gbsAgent.subagentModel.markdownDescription: Optional cheaper/faster model for subagents (codebase exploration). Leave empty to use `#gbsAgent.model#`. A small model here saves a lot of usage.

enumDescriptions: Ask before every file edit and shell command
Apply file edits automatically; ask before shell commands
gbsAgent.permissionMode.markdownDescription: When the agent must ask for approval. Only read from user settings, so a repository cannot change it. Sensitive files (editor/git/CI config, scripts, credentials) always need approval unless this is `auto`.

gbsAgent.openai.baseUrl.description: Base URL of the OpenAI-compatible API (without /chat/completions).

gbsAgent.openai.apiKey.markdownDeprecationMessage: Stored in plain text. Use the **GBS Agent: Set API Key** command, which keeps the key in secret storage and binds it to the endpoint.
gbsAgent.openai.apiKey.description: Legacy: API key in plain text. Prefer the 'GBS Agent: Set API Key' command.

gbsAgent.huggingfaceToken.deprecationMessage: Use the 'GBS Agent: Set API Key' command instead.
gbsAgent.huggingfaceToken.description: Legacy: Hugging Face token (used as the API key when no other key is set).

gbsAgent.contextWindow.description: Model context window in tokens. Sent to Ollama as num_ctx and used to decide when to compact the conversation.

gbsAgent.maxSteps.description: Maximum model calls per request before the agent pauses.

gbsAgent.maxToolOutputChars.description: Tool results longer than this are truncated before being sent to the model.

gbsAgent.shell.description: Shell used for commands (empty = cmd.exe on Windows, $SHELL elsewhere). Example: C:\Program Files\Git\bin\bash.exe

gbsAgent.skills.enabled.markdownDescription: Enable agent skills: folders with a `SKILL.md` that the agent loads when relevant. Only the name and description of each skill are always in the prompt; the instructions load on demand.

gbsAgent.skillsPath.markdownDescription: Folder holding your personal/company skills, available in every project (one sub-folder per skill). Leave empty to use the extension's own folder (command: **GBS Agent: Open Skills Folder**).

scripts.compile: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js
scripts.package: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js --production
scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && npm run lint

untrustedWorkspaces.description: GBS Agent reads, edits and runs code in the workspace, so it is disabled until you trust the folder.
